title: Galois-invariant Néron--Severi ranks of Fermat surfaces over number fields: a Galois module, closed forms, a threshold, and exact tables
summary: For a Fermat surface X_d: x_0^d+x_1^d+x_2^d+x_3^d=0 we compute the Galois-invariant Neron-Severi (Picard) rank rho_K(X_d) = dim (NS(X) \otimes Q)^{Gal(Qbar/K)}: for every subfield K of Q(zeta_d) by an explicit character average -- in closed form for gcd(d,6)=1, with the rational ranks tabulated for 4 <= d <= 30 -- and for an arbitrary number field K through the reduction rho_K = rho_{K \cap L} to the field of definition L. The geometric Picard number is classical (Shioda, Aoki), and L is due to Gvirtz-Chen and Skorobogatov; here we supply the rank layer. As a Gal(Q(zeta_d)/Q)-module the…
